title: The role of nuclear pores and importins for herpes simplex virus infection.
authors: Dohner, Katinka; Serrero, Manutea C; Sodeik, Beate
one_liner_zh: 综述单纯疱疹病毒核孔与importins在感染中的作用，涉及核转运但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Microtubule transport and nuclear import are functionally connected, and the nuclear pore complex (NPC) can interact with microtubule motors. For several alphaherpesvirus proteins, nuclear localization signals (NLSs) and their interactions with specific importin-alpha proteins have been characterized. Here, we review recent insights on the roles of microtubule motors, capsid-associated NLSs, and importin-alpha proteins for capsid transport, capsid docking to NPCs, and genome release into the nucleoplasm, as well as the role of importins for nuclear viral transcription, replication, capsid assembly, genome packaging, and nuclear capsid egress. Moreover, importin-alpha proteins exert antiviral effects by promoting the nuclear import of transcription factors inducing the expression of interferons (IFN), cytokines, and IFN-stimulated genes, and the IFN-inducible MxB restricts capsid docking to NPCs.
abstract_zh: 微管运输与核输入在功能上相互关联，核孔复合体（NPC）能与微管马达蛋白相互作用。对于几种α疱疹病毒蛋白，核定位信号（NLSs）及其与特定importin-α蛋白的相互作用已被表征。在此，我们综述了关于微管马达蛋白、衣壳相关NLSs及importin-α蛋白在衣壳运输、衣壳对接至NPCs、基因组释放入核质中的作用，以及importins在核内病毒转录、复制、衣壳组装、基因组包装和核衣壳输出中的角色的最新见解。此外，importin-α蛋白通过促进转录因子的核输入发挥抗病毒效应，这些转录因子诱导干扰素（IFN）、细胞因子和IFN刺激基因的表达，而IFN诱导的MxB则限制衣壳对接至NPCs。
